docs.text: Name Description T2fc convert from time constant \(T\) [s] to cut-off frequency \(f_c\) [Hz]. T2wc convert from time constant \(T\) [s] to cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s]. fc2T convert from cut-off frequency \(f_c\) [Hz] to time constant \(T\) [s]. fc2wc convert from cut-off frequency \(f_c\) [Hz] to cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s]. wc2T convert from cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s] to time constant \(T\) [s].

docs.title: T2fc
docs.text:
double T2fc(auto const T)

convert from time constant \(T\) [s] to cut-off frequency \(f_c\) [Hz].

\[ f_c = \frac{1}{2\pi T} \] Parameter T Time constant [s] Return cut-off frequency [Hz]

docs.title: T2wc
docs.text:
double T2wc(auto const T)

convert from time constant \(T\) [s] to cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s].

\[ w_c = \frac{1}{T} \] Parameter T Time constant [s] Return cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s]

docs.title: fc2T
docs.text:
double fc2T(auto const fc)

convert from cut-off frequency \(f_c\) [Hz] to time constant \(T\) [s].

\[ T = \frac{1}{2\pi f_c} \] Parameter fc cut-off frequency [Hz] Return Time constant T [s]

docs.title: fc2wc
docs.text:
double fc2wc(auto const fc)

convert from cut-off frequency \(f_c\) [Hz] to cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s].

\[ w_c = 2\pi f_c \] Parameter fc cut-off frequency [Hz] Return cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s]

docs.title: wc2T
docs.text:
double wc2T(auto const wc)

convert from cut-off frequency \(w_c\) [rad/s] to time constant \(T\) [s].

\[ T = \frac{1}{w_c} \] Parameter wc cuf-off frequency [rad/s] Return Time constant [s]
